results.title: India officially bids for 2028 Thomas & Uber Cup Finals, Delhi in contention
results.description: In an exciting development, India has put forward its proposal to host the 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup Finals in Delhi. With its well-established infrastructure and a history of successful event management, Delhi is set to be a fitting venue. This event will be a significant addition to India's history, having previously hosted the championships, and showcasing the men's team's remarkable victory in the 2022 Thomas Cup.
